rows.headlineFinding: A PROTECTED MIS-WRITE REFUSED BY NAME. AOC-CR-288's identifier strip prints Date Of Birth, Full Social Security No. and Age At Time Of Offense in one run and the shared caption capture reads it one blank out of step, so the field named SNN — the FULL SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER blank — is captured with the caption 'Date Of Birth' and the shared semantics bind participant.date_of_birth to it and WRITE IT THERE. SNN is declared unwritable by role. Reported for the lane that owns scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs.

measuredFindingsForWhoeverBuildsIt: OCA model PETITION (sha 7c34e5f5aeee2ce9bb7e757f3c2c9aa9899d536c8917f5329f0d4dc28f6bfa9d), 14 fields over 6 pages. The shared semantics write 6 correctly: Name1 and Name2 (petitioner), Address, Telephone Number, County, and Cause No — which is item (7), the CRIMINAL cause number, and NOT the caption's Cause No. (1), for which the form carries no field at all. Two controls need classification: Dropdown6 at item (9), options 'is' / 'is not', for whether evidence of program completion is attached; and radio Group7 at item (10), Choice1 / Choice2, for whether the required filing fees or a Statement of Inability is included. Both are the participant's, not the route's.

OCA model ORDER (sha 2c9500206f032b2195a6d99ea04310d520413d8ecdc6978da4ba284c2d01189f), 15 fields over 3 pages. It is the PROPOSED order: Judge Presiding is already refused as court-owned, and the four Check Box fields and three date fields are the court's.

STATEMENT OF INABILITY (sha bd17a3fe43d6989d1828c91c9a46c873908c272d8e2e342af35ce8bdb2fab10d), 132 fields over 12 bilingual pages. RUN AGAINST THE SHARED SEMANTICS WITH NO REFUSALS SUPPLIED IT PRODUCES AT LEAST EIGHT MIS-WRITES, and any lane that builds this family must declare them unwritable: the participant's own name is written into ALL FIVE household-member rows ('Name NombreRow1' through 'Name NombreRow5', whose neighbouring columns are Age and Relationship to me); participant.zip is written into 'Mailing  Dirección Postal'; participant.state is written into 'County state', which is the 'signed in ___ County, State of ___' line of the unsworn declaration; and participant.date_of_birth is written into 'Month / Mes', which is the MONTH OF THE DECLARATION DATE and not a birth month. Each of the last three is a false statement on a document signed under penalty of perjury, and the household rows put one person's name in five places that ask for other people.
